name: ZipVoice Distill INT8
description: 中英文零样本克隆。ONNX 静态运行时，体积最小、CPU 速度最快，适合作为默认引擎。
description_en: Zero-shot Chinese/English voice cloning. A static ONNX runtime, smallest download and fastest on CPU — a good default engine.
note: 克隆时必须提供参考音频对应的文字。
note_en: Cloning requires the transcript of the reference audio.

name: Kokoro 82M (INT8)
description: 仅 82M 参数的轻量 TTS，CPU 上即可实时合成；54 个官方预置音色，覆盖中英日法西意葡印地 8 种语言。不支持声音克隆，只能选择内置音色。
description_en: A lightweight 82M-parameter TTS that runs in real time on CPU. 54 official preset voices across 8 languages (English, Chinese, Japanese, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Hindi). No voice cloning — choose a built-in voice.
note: 纯 ONNX 运行时，无需 Python 或编译工具链。该模型只有预置音色：选中后合成页不会出现声音库/录音/参考文字，改为在引擎参数里选择音色。
note_en: Pure ONNX runtime — no Python or build toolchain needed. Preset voices only: when selected, the synth page hides the voice library/recorder/transcript and offers a built-in voice picker.

name: SenseVoice Small (INT8)
description: 本地语音识别（参考音频自动转写）。中英日韩粤，数字与标点自动归一化；录音后可一键填入参考文字，无需手敲。
description_en: On-device speech recognition for automatic reference-clip transcription. Chinese/English/Japanese/Korean/Cantonese with automatic number and punctuation normalization; fills the reference transcript with one tap after recording.
note: 可选组件：仅克隆类引擎（ZipVoice、LongCat、CosyVoice 零样本等）需要参考文字时有用；Kokoro 等预置音色引擎用不到。纯 ONNX，无需 Python。
note_en: Optional: only useful when cloning engines (ZipVoice, LongCat, zero-shot CosyVoice) need a reference transcript; preset-voice engines like Kokoro do not use it. Pure ONNX, no Python needed.

name: VoxCPM2
description: 30 种语言、零样本克隆与声音设计。GGUF 权重经 llama.cpp 在本机推理。
description_en: 30 languages with zero-shot cloning and voice design. GGUF weights run locally through llama.cpp.
note: runner 二进制（约几十 MB）优先从本项目 GitHub Release 的 voxcpm2-runner 下载预编译版本；下载失败且本机有 git/cmake/C++ 工具链时才回退到源码编译。另需下载约 3.3 GB 权重。
note_en: The runner binary (tens of MB) is downloaded prebuilt from this project's voxcpm2-runner GitHub Release first; it falls back to building from source only if that fails and git/cmake/a C++ toolchain are available. The ~3.3 GB weights are downloaded separately.

name: LongCat-AudioDiT 1B
description: 美团 LongCat 的波形潜空间扩散 TTS，零样本克隆效果接近 Seed-TTS；官方 audiodit 包跑在独立 venv 中。
description_en: Meituan's LongCat waveform-latent diffusion TTS, with zero-shot cloning close to Seed-TTS. The official audiodit package runs in an isolated venv.
note: 需要 Python 3.10–3.12 与 Git；克隆需要参考音频对应的文字，音频明显长于文字稿时会自动裁剪；数字会转成中文读法，长文本自动分段合成。单次最长约 30 秒（含参考音频）。可用 LONGCAT_MODEL=meituan-longcat/LongCat-AudioDiT-3.5B 安装更大的版本（~15 GB）。
note_en: Requires Python 3.10–3.12 and Git. Cloning needs the reference transcript; clips much longer than the transcript are trimmed automatically. Numbers are read in Chinese and long text is split into chunks. Each run is capped at ~30 s including the reference. Set LONGCAT_MODEL=meituan-longcat/LongCat-AudioDiT-3.5B for the larger ~15 GB model.

name: dots.tts SOAR (Q8_0)
description: 2B 连续 AR + 48kHz AudioVAE，Seed-TTS 上 SOTA 级克隆；通过 audio.cpp 原生 Metal/CUDA 运行时推理，无需 Python。
description_en: A 2B continuous-AR model with a 48 kHz AudioVAE, SOTA-level cloning on Seed-TTS. Runs on audio.cpp's native Metal/CUDA runtime — no Python needed.
note: 下载 audio.cpp 运行时与 3GB GGUF；默认仅凭声音克隆（文字稿不准确也稳），也可选声纹+文字；长文本自动分段。macOS 走 Metal，其它平台走 CPU。M4 Pro 实测 RTF 约 1.3–1.9。
note_en: Downloads the audio.cpp runtime and a 3 GB GGUF. Clones from the voice alone by default (robust even with an inaccurate transcript), with an optional voice+text mode; long text is split automatically. Metal on macOS, CPU elsewhere. Measured RTF ~1.3–1.9 on an M4 Pro.

name: CosyVoice3 0.5B (Q8_0)
description: FunAudioLLM 的 0.5B 流式 LLM TTS，零样本克隆、跨语种与指令控制；9 种语言 + 粤语，经 audio.cpp 原生 Metal 运行时推理。
description_en: FunAudioLLM's 0.5B streaming LLM TTS with zero-shot cloning, cross-lingual synthesis and voice instructions. 9 languages plus Cantonese, on audio.cpp's native Metal runtime.
note: 与 dots.tts 共用 audio.cpp 运行时（只下载一次）。三种模板：零样本（需文字稿）、跨语种（只凭声音）、指令（用文字描述语气）。
note_en: Shares the audio.cpp runtime with dots.tts (downloaded once). Three templates: zero-shot (needs a transcript), cross-lingual (voice only) and instruct (describe the tone in words).

name: Qwen3-TTS 0.6B
description: 官方 qwen-tts 包，跑在独立的 Python venv 中；10 种语言，仅凭声音即可克隆。
description_en: The official qwen-tts package in an isolated Python venv. 10 languages, cloning from the voice alone.
note: 需要 Python 3.10–3.12；脚本会自动创建隔离环境。Apple Silicon 上自动使用 MPS。
note_en: Requires Python 3.10–3.12; the script creates the isolated environment automatically. Uses MPS automatically on Apple Silicon.

name: Qwen3-TTS 0.6B (custom voice)
description: Qwen3-TTS 预置音色：9 个内置说话人（中英日韩），无需参考音频，并可用自然语言指令调整语气。
description_en: Qwen3-TTS preset speakers: nine built-in voices (Chinese/English/Japanese/Korean) with no reference clip needed, plus natural-language tone instructions.
note: 与克隆版共用同一个 Python 环境，重复安装只下载模型权重。需要 Python 3.10–3.12。
note_en: Shares one Python environment with the clone variant; reinstalling only downloads weights. Requires Python 3.10–3.12.

name: Qwen3-TTS 1.7B (voice design)
description: 用自然语言描述来创造音色（声音设计），例如「一位温柔的年轻女性，语速稍慢」。无需参考音频。
description_en: Create a voice from a natural-language description (voice design), e.g. "a gentle young woman speaking slightly slowly". No reference clip needed.
note: 1.7B 模型，合成时必须填写音色描述。需要 Python 3.10–3.12。
note_en: The 1.7B model; a voice description is required to synthesize. Requires Python 3.10–3.12.
